panels.title: GPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Device utilization from the prover's probe; the probe caches for 2 s, so steps shorter than that are invisible by design.

panels.title: GPU memory used (MiB)
panels.description: Device memory in use. A segment too large for the card shows here as a climb toward the VRAM ceiling before the Groth16 wrap OOMs.

panels.title: GPU power (W)
panels.description: Board power draw; sustained near the card's limit is expected during a proof.

panels.title: Requests by route and outcome
panels.description: Prover HTTP requests split by route and outcome; a rising failure outcome is the first sign of a sick prover.

panels.title: Prover uptime (s)
panels.description: Seconds since the prover process started; a reset means the service restarted.
